workouts.summary: Change speeds and directions on the driveway with both hands and your eyes up the whole time.

drills.name: In-and-Out Rhythm
drills.summary: Sell a crossover with your hand, then keep the ball on the same side.
steps: Get in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the ball in toward your body, then snap it back out.
Do 10 in-and-outs, then switch to your left hand.
Add a step forward on every snap-out.

drills.name: Cross-Behind Counters
drills.summary: Hit a crossover, then counter right away with a behind-the-back.
steps: Start at one end of the driveway at half speed.
Cross right to left, then go behind your back left to right.
Take two hard dribbles forward after the counter.
Walk back and start from the other hand.
Go game speed once both hands are clean.

drills.name: Stop-Start Change-Ups
drills.summary: Go fast, stop on a dime, and explode again without losing the ball.
steps: Sprint dribble 3-4 dribbles down the driveway.
Stop hard on two feet with the ball protected at your hip.
Hold one second with your eyes on the rim.
Explode out with a long first step.
Switch hands every rep.

workouts.summary: Watch game film and learn to see cutters, ball screen coverages and the first seconds of a possession like a point guard.

drills.name: Film: Weak-Side Cutters
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch the players on the side away from the ball.
steps: Pick any college or pro game and start the clock.
Ignore the ball and watch the weak side.
Pause when a player cuts and say why they cut right then.
Notice if the passer saw the cut or missed it.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Hedge or Drop?
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and call the defense on every ball screen.
steps: Find a game with lots of pick-and-roll.
Pause as the screen is set and say the coverage: drop, hedge, switch or trap.
Play it and see what the ball handler did against it.
Say if it was the right read or not.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: First Three Seconds
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch what the point guard does right after a rebound or a make.
steps: Start the clock on any game.
After every rebound or make, watch the point guard for three seconds.
Pause and say: did they push, pitch ahead or slow it down?
Ask yourself what you would have done.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

workouts.summary: Gather strong, change pace on the drive, and finish with either hand around length.

drills.name: Two-Hand Gather Layups
drills.summary: Rip the ball into two hands before every finish to protect it.
steps: Start at the wing with the ball.
Take one dribble toward the rim.
Gather the ball hard into two hands at your chest.
Finish off the glass with your outside hand.
Do both sides of the rim.

drills.name: Change-of-Pace Drives
drills.summary: Slow down to set up the defender, then hit the gas to the rim.
steps: Start at the top of the key.
Dribble at half speed toward the elbow.
Lift your eyes and slow for one dribble.
Explode past the elbow and finish a layup.
Alternate right and left elbows.

drills.name: Long-Arm Finishes
drills.summary: Reach the ball high and away from an imaginary shot blocker.
steps: Drive from the wing with one dribble.
Picture a big at the rim on your inside shoulder.
Shield with your body and extend the ball long.
Finish high off the glass with the hand away from the big.
Do 5 makes each side with each hand.

drills.name: Jump-Stop Pivot Finishes
drills.summary: Drive at game speed, jump stop in the lane, then pivot and finish.
steps: Drive hard from the top of the key.
Jump stop on two feet just outside the block.
Pivot away from the imaginary help defender.
Go up strong and finish off the glass.
Alternate drives to the right and left.

workouts.summary: Clean up your release close in, then shoot on the move and off the dribble at game speed.

drills.name: Rim-Line Form Makes
drills.summary: Groove one clean release from close range before you back up.
steps: Stand one step from the rim, straight on.
Shoot with one hand and hold your follow-through.
Make 5, then take one step back.
Keep going until you reach the free throw line.

drills.name: Lift Cut Threes
drills.summary: Lift from the corner to the wing and shoot on the catch.
steps: Start in the corner with the ball.
Toss the ball out to the wing, or have a rebounder pass it.
Lift up to the wing and catch with your feet ready.
Shoot right away with no extra dribble.
Do 10 shots, then switch sides.

drills.name: Cross-and-Rise Jumpers
drills.summary: Hit a hard crossover, then stop and rise into a pull-up.
steps: Start at the top of the key.
Jab toward one side, then cross hard the other way.
Take one dribble and stop on two feet at the elbow.
Rise straight up and shoot.
Alternate directions and go game speed once it's clean.

workouts.summary: Turn your hips on time, keep a ball handler out of the middle, and close out under control.

drills.name: Swing-Step Turns
drills.summary: Open your hips fast when the ball handler beats your slide.
steps: Start in a low stance on the baseline.
Slide three steps to the right.
Swing your lead foot back to open your hips and run two steps.
Drop back into your stance and slide again.
Go down and back, leading with each side.

drills.name: Lane Wall Contain
drills.summary: Stay in front of a ball handler inside the lane lines with no reaching.
steps: Your partner dribbles from the free throw line toward the baseline.
Stay inside the lane lines and keep your chest in front.
Slide only, no reaching for the ball.
Go 3 reps on defense, then switch.
Partner goes game speed once you're solid.

drills.name: Rim-to-Arc Contests
drills.summary: Close out from the rim to a shooter and contest without flying by.
steps: Start under the rim while your partner stands at the arc.
Partner catches a self-toss and gets ready to shoot.
Sprint out, then chop your feet halfway.
Arrive with a high hand and stay balanced.
Partner shoots or drives; stay in front if they drive.

workouts.summary: Build game-speed lungs with short rest, changing speeds and directions like a guard.

drills.name: Half-Court Tempo Builds
drills.summary: Run half court at three speeds to warm up your engine.
steps: Line up on the baseline.
Jog to half court and walk back.
Run 75% to half court and walk back.
Sprint full speed to half court and walk back.
Repeat the set until time is up.

drills.name: Sprint-Backpedal Ladders
drills.summary: Sprint forward and backpedal back to cones that get farther away.
steps: Set cones at the free throw line, half court and far free throw line.
Sprint to the first cone and backpedal to the baseline.
Do the same for the second and third cones.
Rest 20 seconds and go again.

drills.name: Dribble Down, Slide Back
drills.summary: Speed dribble down the floor, then defensive slide back.
steps: Speed dribble from the baseline to half court.
Leave the ball at half court.
Defensive slide back to the baseline.
Run back, grab the ball and repeat using your other hand.
Rest 20 seconds after each round trip.

drills.name: Minute Makes Challenge
drills.summary: Score as many full-court layups as you can in one minute.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble the full court and finish a layup.
Grab the ball and go right back the other way.
Count your makes in one minute, then rest one minute.
Do it again and try to beat your score.

beginner.summary: Simple one-hand control and a stop-and-go dribble on the driveway, with your eyes up the whole time.

drills.name: Side-to-Side V Dribbles
drills.summary: Control the ball side to side with one hand.
steps: Get in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the ball side to side in front of you, making a V shape.
Keep the ball below your knees.
After 60 seconds, switch to your left hand.

drills.name: Behind-the-Back Basics
drills.summary: Learn a clean behind-the-back dribble while standing still.
steps: Stand in a stance with the ball in your right hand at your hip.
Wrap the ball behind your back to your left hand.
Catch it at your left hip and hold one dribble.
Go back the other way.
Speed up only when every rep is clean.

drills.name: Red Light, Green Light Dribble
drills.summary: Dribble forward, stop in balance, then go again.
steps: Start at one end of the driveway.
Dribble forward at half speed.
Say "red light" and stop in a low stance, still dribbling.
Say "green light" and push off again.
Go up with your right hand and back with your left.

beginner.summary: Watch one player at a time and learn what a good guard does with and without the ball.

drills.name: Film: Pass and Move
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch what one guard does right after passing the ball.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and pick one guard.
Every time they pass, watch only them, not the ball.
Pause and say what they did: cut, space out, or screen.
Notice when they just stood still.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Guarding the Ball
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch one defender guarding the ball handler.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and pick the defender on the ball.
Watch their feet, hands and how far they stand from the ball.
Pause when the ball handler drives.
Say if the defender stayed in front or got beat, and why.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

beginner.summary: Learn clean layup footwork, then finish off a drive from the baseline and the top.

drills.name: Layup Footwork Walk-Through
drills.summary: Learn the two-step layup with no rush.
steps: Start on the right wing, three steps from the rim.
Step right, then left, and lay it up with your right hand.
Walk through it slowly, then go at half speed.
Switch to the left side: left, right, left hand.

drills.name: Baseline Drive Layups
drills.summary: Drive the baseline with one or two dribbles and finish.
steps: Start in the short corner on the right side.
Take one or two dribbles along the baseline.
Finish with your right hand off the glass.
Get your rebound and go to the left side.
Finish with your left hand on that side.

drills.name: Top-of-Key Attack Layups
drills.summary: Drive from the top and finish with the correct hand.
steps: Start at the top of the key.
Drive to the right side with your right hand.
Take two or three dribbles and lay it in right-handed.
Go back to the top and drive left, finishing left-handed.
Keep it controlled and make every layup.

beginner.summary: Build a clean shot close to the rim, move out around the key, then add one dribble.

drills.name: Arc and Hold Shots
drills.summary: Shoot close with high arc and hold your follow-through.
steps: Start one step from the rim, right in front.
Shoot with high arc and hold your follow-through until the ball lands.
Make 3, then take one step back.
Move to the left and right blocks too.

drills.name: Around the Key Set Shots
drills.summary: Hit set shots from spots around the paint.
steps: Pick 5 spots around the edge of the paint.
Square your feet to the rim at each spot.
Make 2 shots, then move to the next spot.
Go around the key twice.

drills.name: One-Dribble Elbow Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Take one dribble, stop in balance and shoot.
steps: Start on the wing facing the elbow.
Take one dribble toward the elbow.
Jump stop with both feet square to the rim.
Rise up and shoot.
Do 5 reps going right, then 5 going left.

beginner.summary: Learn to slide without crossing your feet, then use it against a partner on the drive and the closeout.

drills.name: Push-Step Line Slides
drills.summary: Slide along a line with good stance and no crossed feet.
steps: Get in a stance with your feet wide on a line.
Push off your back foot and step with your lead foot.
Slide 5 steps one way, then 5 back.
Keep your hands active and your back flat.

drills.name: Cushion and Contain
drills.summary: Stay an arm's length in front of a slow dribbler.
steps: Set 2 cones about 4 big steps apart to make a lane.
Your partner dribbles at half speed down the lane.
Slide and keep one arm's length between you.
Go baseline to half-court, then switch roles.
No reaching for the ball.

drills.name: Corner Closeout Stops
drills.summary: Run at a shooter, then stop under control.
steps: Your partner stands in the corner holding the ball.
Start in the middle of the paint.
Sprint halfway, then take short, choppy steps.
Stop an arm's length away with one hand high.
Hold your stance for 2 seconds, then reset.
Do 5 reps, then switch roles.

beginner.summary: Short runs and dribble repeats at game speed to build a guard's engine.

drills.name: Cone Shuttle Runs
drills.summary: Run out and back to cones at a steady, quick pace.
steps: Set cones 5, 10 and 15 steps from the baseline.
Run to the first cone, touch it, and run back.
Do the same for the second and third cones.
Rest 30 seconds and repeat once.

drills.name: Baseline-Half Dribble Repeats
drills.summary: Speed dribble to half-court and back with short rest.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to half-court with your right hand.
Come back with your left hand.
Work 20 seconds, rest 20 seconds.
Keep going until time is up.

drills.name: Three-Cone Triangle Runs
drills.summary: Sprint, slide and backpedal around a triangle of cones.
steps: Set 3 cones in a triangle, about 6 steps apart.
Sprint from cone 1 to cone 2.
Defensive slide from cone 2 to cone 3.
Backpedal from cone 3 back to cone 1.
Work 30 seconds, rest 20 seconds, then go the other way.

advanced.summary: Game-speed combos with your eyes locked up and both hands working, built to hold up when your legs are tired.

drills.name: Pocket Pull Rhythm
drills.summary: Pull the ball into your pocket and keep a steady rhythm with both hands.
steps: Stand in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Pound hard and pull the ball back to your hip pocket on every dribble.
Do 30 seconds right, then 30 seconds left.
Add a crossover every third dribble and keep the pocket pull.
Finish with 60 seconds of switching hands at full speed.

drills.name: Fixed-Target Moves
drills.summary: Lock your eyes on one spot and make every move without looking down.
steps: Pick a target at head height, like the rim or a garage light.
Keep your eyes on it the whole time.
Do 20 seconds each: crossover, between the legs, behind the back.
Then mix all three in any order at full speed.
If you look down, restart that move.

drills.name: Hesi-Cross-Spin Chains
drills.summary: Chain three moves together and explode out of the last one.
steps: Start at one end of the driveway at game speed.
Hesitate, then cross over, then spin the other way.
Explode three hard dribbles out of the spin.
Walk back and start from the other hand.
Every rep, change the order of the moves.

drills.name: Sixty-Second Shift Rounds
drills.summary: Five 60-second rounds of nonstop combos to keep your handle clean when you're tired.
steps: Set a 60-second timer with 15 seconds rest between rounds.
Round 1: cross and between the legs, nonstop.
Round 2: behind the back and in-and-out.
Round 3: your best two-move combo, both directions.
Rounds 4 and 5: make up combos on the fly, no repeats.

advanced.summary: Scout like a varsity point guard: hunt mismatches, break down zone gaps and make the right late-game clock calls.

drills.name: Film: Hunt the Mismatch
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch how teams force switches and attack the weak defender.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch for switches on screens.
After every switch, pause and say who the mismatch is.
Say how the offense should attack it: post up, iso or drive.
Watch if they used it or wasted it.
Write two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Zone Seams and Gaps
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Find where a zone is weak and how guards split it.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film against a zone defense.
Pause each trip and say the zone type: 2-3, 3-2 or 1-3-1.
Point out the gaps between defenders and the open high post.
Watch for a guard driving the gap to pull two defenders.
Say who was open after the pass.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Clock and Score Calls
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Study the last two minutes of close games and judge every clock decision.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of the final two minutes of close games.
Before each possession, pause and say the score, clock and fouls.
Say your call: 2-for-1, hold for the last shot, or foul.
Play it and see what the team did.
Note any timeout or foul you would have done differently.
Write two takeaways in your notebook.

advanced.summary: Attack the rim at full speed with late gathers, hang-time finishes and tired-legs reps from every angle.

drills.name: Low-Gather Rip Finishes
drills.summary: Gather low and away from the defender, then rip up and finish.
steps: Start on the right wing.
Drive two hard dribbles to the rim.
Gather the ball low by your outside hip.
Rip it up high and finish with the right hand.
Do 2 minutes each side, finishing with the outside hand.

drills.name: Rim Attack Dribble Combos
drills.summary: Hit a combo move at the arc and get downhill in two dribbles.
steps: Start at the top of the key, facing the rim.
Hit a combo: hesi-cross, in-and-out or between-cross.
Get to the rim in two dribbles and finish.
Rotate through all three combos, both hands.
Every rep at full game speed.

drills.name: Delay Layup Hangs
drills.summary: Hold the ball one beat longer to beat a shot blocker's timing.
steps: Drive from the wing at full speed.
Jump off one foot and keep the ball high and tight.
Wait for the shot blocker to come down in your head, then release.
Finish off the glass with either hand.
Alternate wings and hands every rep.

drills.name: Five-Spot Rim Gauntlet
drills.summary: Nonstop drives from five spots with a different finish each time.
steps: Set five spots: both corners, both wings, top.
Drive from a spot and finish, grab the rebound, sprint to the next spot.
Finishes rotate: right hand, left hand, reverse, floater, two-foot.
Go 60 seconds on, 15 seconds rest.
Count makes and beat your score next round.

advanced.summary: Build range, shoot off the sprint and the dribble, then hit shots under game-winner pressure.

drills.name: Hold-the-Finish Range Walk
drills.summary: Groove your shot from close and step back only when you make it.
steps: Start 5 feet in front of the rim.
Shoot and hold your follow-through until the ball lands.
Make 2 in a row, then take one step back.
Miss 2 in a row, take one step in.
Work out to the three-point line.

drills.name: Sprint-to-Spot Catch Threes
drills.summary: Sprint to the arc, catch on balance and fire.
steps: Start under the rim.
Sprint to a three-point spot, hands ready.
Catch from a rebounder or self-toss and shoot right away.
Sprint back to the rim and go to the next spot.
Rotate five spots, count makes.

drills.name: Side-Dribble Pull-Up Combos
drills.summary: Shake a defender with a dribble move and pull up on balance.
steps: Start on the wing at the arc.
Jab, then one hard dribble right and pull up.
Next rep, one dribble left and pull up.
Then crossover into a pull-up both ways.
Shoot from midrange first, then the arc.

drills.name: Game-Winner Shot Series
drills.summary: Count down from 5 and make the last shot of the game.
steps: Start at half court with the ball.
Count down from 5 out loud as you attack.
Get to your best shot before 0 and shoot.
Score it: 3 for a three, 2 for a two, 0 for a miss.
Play to 15 points, then do it again from the other side.

advanced.summary: Explosive first slides, fighting over screens and stunt-and-recover reps, then live stops against a partner.

drills.name: Explosive First-Slide Starts
drills.summary: Win the first step when a guard tries to blow by you.
steps: Get in stance on a line with cones 3 big steps to each side.
Push off your inside foot hard to the right cone.
Slide back to the middle and hold stance for a second.
Go left, then right, at full speed.
Do 30 seconds on, 10 seconds rest.

drills.name: Cone Screen Fight-Overs
drills.summary: Get skinny and fight over a ball screen without losing your man.
steps: Set a cone at the elbow as the screener.
Slide toward the cone like you are guarding the ball.
Turn your hips, get skinny and squeeze over the top of the cone.
Recover back into stance on the other side.
Go both directions, full speed.

drills.name: Stunt and Recover Reps
drills.summary: Stunt at the driver, then recover to your shooter fast.
steps: Set a cone on the wing as your shooter.
Start in help position in the lane.
Take a hard stunt step toward the middle with your hands up.
Recover and close out to the wing cone with short chop steps.
Repeat from both sides at game speed.

drills.name: Iso Stop Streaks
drills.summary: Get stops against a partner with a three-dribble limit.
steps: Partner starts with the ball on the wing.
Partner gets three dribbles to score.
Guard the ball, no reaching, contest the shot.
Count your stops in a row.
Switch roles every 60 seconds.

advanced.summary: Game-speed tempo runs, diagonal closeouts and full-court possessions with short rest so your legs hold up late.

drills.name: Dribble-Stop Tempo Waves
drills.summary: Change speeds full court with hard stops at every line.
steps: Dribble from the baseline at full speed.
Hard stop at the free throw line, hesitate, then sprint.
Hard stop at half court and far free throw line.
Sprint back with the other hand.
Go 45 seconds on, 15 seconds rest.

drills.name: Diagonal Closeout Runs
drills.summary: Sprint corner to corner and close out at each cone.
steps: Set a cone at each corner of the half court.
Sprint diagonal from one corner to the far cone.
Break down into a closeout with chop steps at the cone.
Sprint to the next corner.
Go 40 seconds on, 20 seconds rest.

drills.name: Defend-and-Break Bursts
drills.summary: Slide hard on defense, then flip your hips and sprint out.
steps: Start in stance on the lane line.
Slide across the lane and back two times.
Open your hips and sprint to half court.
Backpedal back to the lane.
Repeat with 15 seconds rest between sets.

drills.name: Full-Court Clock Possessions
drills.summary: Play full-court possessions on a 24-second clock until you are tired.
steps: Set two cones as defenders on the way up the floor.
Push the ball full court and hit a move at each cone.
Finish at the rim, grab it and push back the other way.
Each trip must be done before 24 seconds.
Rest 10 seconds, then go again.
